selection.rationale: One case per service-fault pair, with repetitions balanced across the 5x5 Latin-square selection.

preprocessing.label_rule: 0 before inject_time; 1 at or after inject_time
preprocessing.feature_scope: intersection across all selected cases, with at least one finite observation in every case
feature_priority: other service workload and latency metrics
other service CPU and memory metrics
preprocessing.missing_value_rule: Per case, linear interpolation in time followed by forward and backward fill.

evidence_boundaries: The benchmark is a historical, controlled microservice dataset, not a live production deployment.
Local diagnostic detector results are kept separate from results produced by the deployed CloudSentinel workflow.
Using the published injection time for RCA evaluates ranking with a known change point; it does not evaluate change-point detection.
The fixed 100-feature profile is an adaptation to CloudSentinel's current CSV import contract and is reported as such.
